player.mendes.kyle.claimEn: The Eredivisie's dribbling king, with pace as his deadliest weapon. Give him the ball and he is past his man in a blink, his surges down the flank pure wind. Especially dangerous on the counter and over long carries.
player.mendes.kyle.evidenceEn: Scout's verdict: erratic crossing, ordinary physicality, finishing needs work.
player.mendes.kyle.careerHistory: 2021–2023 风车城青训；2023–2026 鹿特丹橙一线队，三个赛季把对方右后卫的跑动数据刷成联盟第一。
player.mendes.kyle.careerHistoryEn: 2021–2023 Windmill City academy; 2023–2026 Rotterdam Orange FC first team — three seasons of turning opposing right-backs' running stats into league-leading numbers.
player.mendes.kyle.expirySubject: 门德斯签约田径队：终于不用练传中了
player.mendes.kyle.expirySubjectEn: Mendes signs for athletics club: crossing practice finally over
player.mendes.kyle.expiryBody: 据《边线周刊》报道，Kyle Mendes 已与本地田径俱乐部签约改练百米。其经纪人表示，球员本人认为“传中不稳定”的短板在田径赛场将不复存在——那里根本没有传中。告别活动上他沿边路全速冲刺90米，现场观众热烈鼓掌，直到有人问了一句：底线外那脚球传中了没有？
player.mendes.kyle.expiryBodyEn: The Touchline Weekly reports Kyle Mendes has signed with a local athletics club to run the 100m. His agent says the player believes his “erratic crossing” will cease to be a weakness on the track — there is no crossing there. At the farewell event he sprinted 90 metres flat out down the wing to warm applause, until someone asked: did that ball over the byline ever get crossed in?

resumeMail.sender: 橙光经纪 · 范德普尔
resumeMail.senderEn: Orange Glow Agency · Van der Poel
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Kyle Mendes
resumeMail.preview: 荷甲过人王，速度毋庸置疑，传中另议。
resumeMail.previewEn: Eredivisie dribbling king. Pace beyond doubt; crossing negotiable.
resumeMail.body: 现推荐边锋 Kyle Mendes：荷甲过人王，启动速度令整条边路闻风丧胆，反击中拿球约等于直接快进。球探报告提到传中与终结仍需打磨，我方理解为“升值空间充足”。可随时安排试训，请自备秒表。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Presenting winger Kyle Mendes: Eredivisie dribbling king, with take-off speed that terrifies entire flanks; on the counter, him receiving the ball is effectively a fast-forward button. The scout report notes crossing and finishing need polish — we read that as “generous headroom for appreciation”. Trial available anytime; bring your own stopwatch.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 数据可核，缺点轻描淡写
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · stats verifiable, flaws lightly glazed over

player.ferreira.antonio.biographyEn: The most unremarkable man in football — and the least willing to give up
player.ferreira.antonio.claimEn: A veteran defender who has grinded through 18 years in the lower leagues. No glamour clubs, no glittering CV, but hard-nosed defending, excellent positioning and deep experience have kept him at professional level.
player.ferreira.antonio.evidenceEn: A former teammate: “Antonio is no genius — he just lasted ten years longer than everyone else.”
player.ferreira.antonio.careerHistory: 2007–2025 先后效力七支低级别球队，队徽换了七次，铲球动作一次没换。
player.ferreira.antonio.careerHistoryEn: 2007–2025 Seven lower-league clubs in a row — seven badge changes, zero changes to the tackle.
player.ferreira.antonio.expirySubject: 费雷拉挂靴：去当防守教练了
player.ferreira.antonio.expirySubjectEn: Ferreira hangs up his boots: off to be a defensive coach
player.ferreira.antonio.expiryBody: 十八年职业生涯后，Antonio Ferreira 宣布退役，出任家乡俱乐部防守教练。发布会上他说：“我不是天才，只是比所有人多坚持了十年——现在轮到我把这十年教给别人。”俱乐部宣布保留他的更衣柜，理由是“他大概率还会想回来踢两场”。
player.ferreira.antonio.expiryBodyEn: After an eighteen-year career, Antonio Ferreira has retired to become his hometown club's defensive coach. “I'm no genius,” he said at the presser. “I just stuck at it ten years longer than everyone else — now it's my turn to teach those ten years to someone else.” The club announced it will keep his locker, reasoning that “he'll probably want to come back for a couple of games”.

resumeMail.sender: 老将自荐 · 安东尼奥
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Antonio Ferreira
resumeMail.preview: 十八年低级别老兵，没有高光，只有卡位。
resumeMail.previewEn: Eighteen-year lower-league veteran. No highlights, just positioning.
resumeMail.body: 您好，我是 Antonio Ferreira，自己写邮件，省一笔中介费。十八年低级别联赛履历，没有豪门，但每任教练走之前都想带我走。位置感和经验随信附上，速度部分请勿追问。工资好商量，更衣柜靠门就行。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Hello, Antonio Ferreira here, writing my own email to save an agent's fee. Eighteen years in the lower leagues — no glamour clubs, but every manager tried to take me with him when he left. Positioning and experience enclosed; please don't ask about the pace. Wages negotiable; a locker by the door will do.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 球员自荐 · 前队友旁证，大体可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Player self-recommendation · corroborated by former teammates, broadly credible

player.mora.victor.claimEn: Mora is renowned for astonishing saves, especially from close range and one-on-ones. Faced with certain goals, he somehow keeps them out with incredible reflexes.
player.mora.victor.evidenceEn: Most clean sheets in a Belgian league season.
player.mora.victor.careerHistory: 2018–2022 熔岩竞技青训与预备队；2022–2026 灯塔港主力门将，对手射门欲望逐年下降。
player.mora.victor.careerHistoryEn: 2018–2022 Lava Athletic academy and reserves; 2022–2026 first-choice keeper at Lighthouse Harbour FC, with opponents' desire to shoot declining year on year.
player.mora.victor.expirySubject: 莫拉签约王座队：零封奖金另行结算
player.mora.victor.expirySubjectEn: Mora signs for Throne City: clean-sheet bonuses billed separately
player.mora.victor.expiryBody: 据《门线月报》消息，Victor Mora 已与王座队签约三年。对方主帅表示，看中的不只是零封纪录，而是“他往门前一站，对方前锋先叹气”。签约仪式特意安排在老东家的球门前举行，主办方解释：这是他让最多射门停下的地方，适合让谈判也停下来。
player.mora.victor.expiryBodyEn: The Goal Line Monthly reports Victor Mora has signed a three-year deal with Throne City FC. Their manager says it isn't just the clean-sheet record — it's that “when he takes his place in goal, the opposing striker sighs first”. The signing ceremony was deliberately staged in front of his old club's goalmouth; organisers explained it's where he has stopped the most shots, so it seemed right to stop the negotiations there too.

resumeMail.sender: 铁塔经纪 · 范布隆克
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Victor Mora
resumeMail.preview: 比甲零封王，擅长让单刀变成单相思。
resumeMail.previewEn: Belgian league clean-sheet king; turns one-on-ones into unrequited love.
resumeMail.body: 委托推荐门将 Victor Mora：近距离扑救反应顶级，单刀球是他的私人恩怨，上赛季零封场次比甲第一。前锋见了他通常先失去信心，再失去球权。转会费面议，零封奖金的写法我们已经有模板了。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Commissioned to recommend goalkeeper Victor Mora: elite close-range reflexes; one-on-ones are a personal grudge of his, and last season's clean sheets topped the Belgian league. Strikers who meet him generally lose their confidence first, then the ball. Fee negotiable; we already have a template for the clean-sheet bonus clause.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 零封数据可查，可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · clean-sheet data verifiable, credible

player.rosales.diego.biographyEn: Possibly related to one of the greatest players in football history
player.rosales.diego.claimEn: He claims to be a distant relative of an Argentine football legend and says his talent comes from “family genetics”. The story earned him plenty of attention in youth football.
player.rosales.diego.evidenceEn: Rosales's neighbour told reporters: “The kid's talent is real. He played differently from everyone even as a boy. The legend himself once came to their house for dinner!”
player.rosales.diego.careerHistory: 2022–2024 高原雄鹰青年队；2024–2026 河谷之星，家谱被引用次数多于出场次数。
player.rosales.diego.careerHistoryEn: 2022–2024 Plateau Eagles youth; 2024–2026 Valley Stars — his family tree cited more often than his appearances.
player.rosales.diego.expirySubject: 罗萨莱斯转行：去拍家族真人秀
player.rosales.diego.expirySubjectEn: Rosales changes careers: off to star in a family reality show
player.rosales.diego.expiryBody: Diego  Rosales 宣布暂别足坛，加盟一档家族真人秀，专门讲述“传奇亲戚”的日常。制作方看中的正是他那句名言：“天赋是家族遗传的。”节目组曾试图联系球王本人求证，至今无人接听——邻居表示，这恰恰说明确有其事。
player.rosales.diego.expiryBodyEn: Diego Rosales has stepped away from football to join a family reality show about life with a “legendary relative”. Producers were sold on his famous line: “Talent runs in the family.” The crew tried calling the great man himself for verification — no answer, which the neighbours say only proves it's true.

resumeMail.sender: 家族事务办 · 表叔
resumeMail.senderEn: Family Affairs Office · the Second Uncle
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Diego  Rosales
resumeMail.preview: 阿根廷传奇球王远亲自荐，证据在邻居手里。
resumeMail.previewEn: Distant relative of an Argentine legend, self-recommended. Evidence held by the neighbours.
resumeMail.body: 兹有 Diego  Rosales 先生委托投递简历。其足球天赋据信源自家族遗传，青年联赛期间已凭这个故事获得大量关注。邻居可以作证：“球王本人还去他家吃过饭。”血统证书正在补办，在那之前，先踢球也行。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Mr Diego Rosales has asked us to submit his CV. His footballing talent is believed to be hereditary, a story that earned him considerable attention in youth football. The neighbours can vouch: “The legend himself once came to their house for dinner.” The pedigree certificate is being reissued; until then, he's happy to just play football.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 家属代投 · 故事动听，可信度自辨
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Submitted by family · lovely story, credibility yours to judge

player.costa.bruno.claimEn: Bruno is a pure wrecking machine on the flank, feared by every winger in France. Opponents describe him as a 200 km/h tank.
player.costa.bruno.evidenceEn: A former teammate: “When he gets going in training, everyone's first instinct isn't to win the ball — it's to get out of the way.”
player.costa.bruno.careerHistory: 2019–2023 南部港口联；2023–2026 雄鸡城竞技，三年撞断的角旗杆已有专人统计。
player.costa.bruno.careerHistoryEn: 2019–2023 Southport United; 2023–2026 Rooster City Athletic — the corner flags he's snapped in three years now have a dedicated statistician.
player.costa.bruno.expirySubject: 科斯塔签约碰撞城：坦克找到停车场
player.costa.bruno.expirySubjectEn: Costa signs for Collision City: the tank finds a parking space
player.costa.bruno.expiryBody: Bruno Costa 已与碰撞城签约，该队上赛季被过掉的边锋人数联赛第一，急需以暴制暴。体检时队医为他测冲刺速度，测速仪厂商随后发来感谢函：“感谢你们帮我们发现了产品上限。”对方边锋工会已就此次签约发表声明，表示“深切关切”。
player.costa.bruno.expiryBodyEn: Bruno Costa has signed for Collision City FC, whose wingers were dribbled past more than anyone else's last season; they need to fight fire with fire. During his medical the club doctor timed his sprint, and the speed-gun manufacturer later sent a thank-you letter: “You've helped us discover our product's upper limit.” The opposing wingers' union has issued a statement expressing “deep concern”.

resumeMail.sender: 重坦经纪 · 杜邦
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Bruno Costa
resumeMail.preview: 边路坦克一辆，让路者生还率百分之百。
resumeMail.previewEn: One flank tank for sale. Survival rate for those who get out of the way: 100%.
resumeMail.body: 推荐边后卫 Bruno Costa：纯粹的力量型冲击机器，训练赛里他一启动，队友的第一反应不是抢球，是让路。法国边锋群体对他已形成成熟的恐惧体系。对抗与往返能力顶级，技术细节属于“撞开就好”的范畴。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending wing-back Bruno Costa: a pure power-driven battering ram. When he starts moving in training games, his own teammates' first instinct isn't to win the ball — it's to get out of the way. French wingers have developed a mature, well-organised fear of him. Top-tier duelling and shuttling; the finer technical details fall under “just barge through”.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 前队友证词，大体可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · former teammates' testimony, broadly credible

player.silva.marco.claimEn: His greatest weapon isn't technique but stamina. Still running at speed after 90 minutes, still sprinting in the final minutes of extra time — a famous endurance monster in training too.
player.silva.marco.evidenceEn: His primary-school PE teacher: “He ran distance races as a kid; stamina has always been his standout trait.”
player.silva.marco.careerHistory: 2020–2023 双半程；2023–2026 海岸马拉松竞技，赛后主动加练，保安已习惯最后一个关灯。
player.silva.marco.careerHistoryEn: 2020–2023 Two Halves United; 2023–2026 Coastal Marathon Athletic, where he volunteers for extra running after matches and security are used to him turning the last light off.
player.silva.marco.expirySubject: 席尔瓦改练长跑：足球圈松了口气
player.silva.marco.expirySubjectEn: Silva switches to distance running: football breathes a sigh of relief
player.silva.marco.expiryBody: 据《九十分钟》报道，Marco Silva 正式转投职业长跑队。他在告别信里写道：“感谢足球让我明白，我最爱的是跑本身。”老东家体能教练闻讯落泪——不是不舍，是终于不用再回答“他到底什么时候累”这个问题。对方中卫群体则表示情绪稳定。
player.silva.marco.expiryBodyEn: Ninety Minutes reports Marco Silva has officially joined a professional distance-running squad. “Thank you, football,” he wrote in his farewell letter, “for teaching me that what I love most is the running itself.” His old fitness coach wept at the news — not from sorrow, but because he'll never again have to answer “when does he actually get tired?”. Opposition centre-backs report their emotions are stable.

resumeMail.sender: 耐力无限经纪 · 佩雷拉
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Marco Silva
resumeMail.preview: 90分钟后还能冲刺的前锋，加时赛是舒适区。
resumeMail.previewEn: A forward still sprinting after 90 minutes; extra time is his comfort zone.
resumeMail.body: 推荐前锋 Marco Silva：技术是副业，体能是本行。90分钟后依旧高速奔跑，加时赛最后几分钟还能冲刺，对方中卫最怕听到的一句话是“席尔瓦还没下场”。小学长跑出身的底子，耐力这东西他从没续过费。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending forward Marco Silva: technique is his side hustle, stamina is the day job. Still running at full pelt after 90 minutes, still sprinting in the last minutes of extra time; the sentence opposition centre-backs dread most is “Silva's still on”. A schoolboy distance runner by upbringing — his stamina has never needed a renewal fee.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 体育老师证词，大体可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · PE teacher's testimony, broadly credible

player.onaku.andre.biographyEn: Not a goalkeeper in the traditional sense
player.onaku.andre.claimEn: Blessed with excellent footwork and attacking instinct. In the academy, coaches noticed his reactions far exceeded his peers' and converted him into a goalkeeper — a switch that made him a modern, ball-playing keeper, though his shot-stopping is ordinary.
player.onaku.andre.evidenceEn: Superb distribution; regularly joins the build-up and is considered the organiser in Milan's tactical system.
player.onaku.andre.careerHistory: 2018–2021 缝纫机城青训（前锋改门将）；2021–2026 时尚之都竞技，场均触球次数让中场汗颜。
player.onaku.andre.careerHistoryEn: 2018–2021 Sewing Machine City academy (converted from striker to keeper); 2021–2026 Fashion Capital Athletic, where his touches per game embarrass the midfield.
player.onaku.andre.expirySubject: 奥纳库签约鹿特丹橙：后场组织者就位
player.onaku.andre.expirySubjectEn: Onaku signs for Rotterdam Orange: deep-lying playmaker installed
player.onaku.andre.expiryBody: André Onaku 已与鹿特丹橙签约。光头主帅在发布会上表示：“我们要的不是站在门线上的门将，而是后场第一名组织者。”奥纳库当场用脚弓推传完成签字仪式，皮球穿过三名中场，准确停在新任队长脚下。扑救训练被安排在发布会之后补做。
player.onaku.andre.expiryBodyEn: André Onaku has signed for Rotterdam Orange FC. “We don't want a keeper who stands on his line,” the bald manager said at the unveiling. “We want our first playmaker at the back.” Onaku sealed the ceremony with an inside-of-the-foot pass that threaded through three midfielders and stopped dead at the new captain's feet. Shot-stopping practice was scheduled afterwards, to catch up.

resumeMail.sender: 新派门将经纪 · 德克
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：André Onaku
resumeMail.preview: 用脚踢球的门将，后场组织从他脚下开始。
resumeMail.previewEn: A keeper who plays with his feet; the build-up starts with him.
resumeMail.body: 推荐门将 André Onaku：青训时因反应过快从前锋改造为门将，脚下技术和进攻意识保留至今，常参与后场组织，是体系里的第一出球点。扑救能力业内评价为“够用”——组织型门将，下单前请想清楚。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending goalkeeper André Onaku: converted from striker to keeper in the academy because his reactions were too quick, and he's kept the footwork and attacking instinct ever since. Regularly joins the build-up as the system's first outlet. His shot-stopping is rated “adequate” by the industry — he's a playmaking keeper, so please be sure before ordering.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 体系评价主观，谨慎参考
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · system verdicts subjective, handle with care

player.rivas.j.claimEn: A once world-class midfielder, famous for his left foot, passing and long-range shooting, who played for European giants and at the World Cup for his country. A serious injury took him out of the game, and he has barely played competitive football in three years.
player.rivas.j.evidenceEn: The latest training footage confirms the technique remains; physical condition is the big question.
player.rivas.j.careerHistory: 2008–2019 欧洲多家豪门，左脚集锦全长四小时；2022 重伤离队；2023–2026 在康复与传闻之间徘徊。
player.rivas.j.careerHistoryEn: 2008–2019 Several European giants; the left-foot highlight reel runs four hours. 2022 departed with a serious injury; 2023–2026 drifting between rehab and rumour.
player.rivas.j.expirySubject: 里瓦斯签约金色沙丘：传奇按年计费
player.rivas.j.expirySubjectEn: Rivas signs for Golden Dune: a legend billed by the year
player.rivas.j.expiryBody: J. Rivas 已与海湾金色沙丘队签约两年，转会费未公布，俱乐部声明只有四个字：“钱不是问题。”体检报告提示身体仍需谨慎管理，主帅回应：“我们买的是他的左脚和名字，膝盖算附赠品。”首秀门票三小时售罄，黄牛已开始在球场外练习他的签名。
player.rivas.j.expiryBodyEn: J. Rivas has signed a two-year deal with Gulf side Golden Dune United. The fee is undisclosed; the club statement ran to just four words: “Money is no object.” The medical advised careful management of his body, to which the manager replied: “We're buying the left foot and the name — the knees come free.” Debut tickets sold out in three hours, and touts are already practising his autograph outside the ground.

resumeMail.sender: 里瓦斯团队 · 首席助理
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：J. Rivas · 传奇回归
resumeMail.subjectEn: Player CV: J. Rivas · return of a legend
resumeMail.preview: 左脚还在，身体待考，名气管够。
resumeMail.previewEn: The left foot is intact, the body under review, the fame fully stocked.
resumeMail.body: 受 J. Rivas 先生委托发送简历。前世界级中场，左脚、传球、远射皆属教科书级别，最新训练录像确认技术完好。过去三年鲜少正式比赛，身体状态是唯一疑问。诚寻一支懂得分期使用传奇的球队。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Sent on behalf of Mr J. Rivas. Former world-class midfielder; the left foot, the passing and the long-range shooting are all textbook, and the latest training footage confirms the technique is intact. He has played little competitive football in three years — fitness is the only question. Seeking a club that understands how to use a legend in instalments.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 球员团队材料 · 录像可查，身体需复检
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Player's team material · footage verifiable, body needs a second look

player.vieira.lucas.biographyEn: One of the most talked-about young talents in South American football in recent years
player.vieira.lucas.claimEn: Born in a São Paulo favela, he honed his technique in street football from childhood. At 15 he was spotted by scouts and brought into a professional academy.
player.vieira.lucas.evidenceEn: In one youth match, Lucas beat three defenders in a row to score the winner.
player.vieira.lucas.careerHistory: 2023–2025 圣保罗街头全明星；2025–2026 未来之星青训，连过三人的视频至今循环播放。
player.vieira.lucas.careerHistoryEn: 2023–2025 São Paulo Street All-Stars; 2025–2026 Future Stars FC academy — the video of him beating three men is still on loop.
player.vieira.lucas.expirySubject: 维埃拉登陆欧洲：行李箱装着整条街
player.vieira.lucas.expirySubjectEn: Vieira lands in Europe: suitcase packed with an entire street
player.vieira.lucas.expiryBody: Lucas Vieira 已正式签约一家欧洲俱乐部，细节保密。据《绿金足球报》报道，签约当天他老家整条街放假半天，街坊把当年连过三人绝杀的视频投在教堂外墙上循环播放。青训教练表示唯一的担心是：“他以为每场训练都是街头决赛。”
player.vieira.lucas.expiryBodyEn: Lucas Vieira has officially signed for a European club, details confidential. The Green-and-Gold Gazette reports his whole street back home took half a day off, neighbours projecting the old video of his three-man dribble-and-winner onto the church wall on a loop. His academy coach's only concern: “He thinks every training session is a street final.”

resumeMail.sender: 街头星探 · 卡洛琳
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Lucas Vieira
resumeMail.preview: 圣保罗街头走出的天才，过人像呼吸。
resumeMail.previewEn: A talent off the streets of São Paulo; he dribbles like he breathes.
resumeMail.body: 推荐中场 Lucas Vieira：圣保罗贫民区街头足球出身，15岁被球探相中进入青训体系。青年队比赛曾连过三人完成绝杀，录像随时可发。技术和灵气都是顶配，欠缺的只是欧洲赛场的经验——这恰好是贵队能给的部分。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending midfielder Lucas Vieira: raised on street football in a São Paulo favela, spotted by scouts at 15 and brought into the academy. Once beat three men straight to score a youth-team winner — footage available on request. Technique and flair are top-spec; all he lacks is European experience, which happens to be exactly what your club can supply.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 球探一手材料 · 有青年赛录像佐证
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Scout's first-hand material · backed by youth-match footage

player.ferreira.jose.claimEn: Portugal's third and fourth tiers, eight clubs. Never played top-flight football, but always the captain.
player.ferreira.jose.evidenceEn: Teammates' verdict: tough and vastly experienced; the pace has gone.
player.ferreira.jose.careerHistory: 2003–2026 葡萄牙三四级联赛八队流浪，戴过队长袖标的场次比某些球队的历史还长。
player.ferreira.jose.careerHistoryEn: 2003–2026 A nomad across eight clubs in Portugal's third and fourth tiers; he has worn the armband more times than some of those clubs have histories.
player.ferreira.jose.expirySubject: 老队长挂靴：八队联名退役袖标
player.ferreira.jose.expirySubjectEn: The old captain hangs up his boots: eight clubs jointly retire the armband
player.ferreira.jose.expiryBody: José Ferreira 宣布退役，八家效力过的俱乐部罕见发布联合声明：“他从没踢过顶级联赛，但每一副袖标都因他更有分量。”告别赛他踢了六十分钟，跑动不多，嗓门全场第一。退役后他出任青训纪律顾问，第一课题目是《如何站着就把人骂醒》。
player.ferreira.jose.expiryBodyEn: José Ferreira has retired, and the eight clubs he served issued a rare joint statement: “He never played top-flight football, but every armband weighed more for having been his.” He played sixty minutes of his farewell match — little running, loudest voice on the pitch. He now serves as an academy discipline consultant; lesson one is titled “How to Tell Someone Off Without Leaving Your Chair”.

resumeMail.sender: 老将互助会 · 若昂
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：José Ferreira
resumeMail.preview: 八支球队的老队长，没输过更衣室。
resumeMail.previewEn: Old captain of eight clubs; never lost a dressing room.
resumeMail.body: 代 José Ferreira 投递简历：葡萄牙三四级联赛二十余年，效力八支球队，到哪里都是队长。身体和速度已不在巅峰，但强硬与经验属于免检产品。适合需要有人镇住更衣室的球队，工资要求和他本人一样朴实。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Submitting a CV on behalf of José Ferreira: twenty-odd years in Portugal's third and fourth tiers, eight clubs, captain wherever he went. Body and pace are past their peak, but the steel and experience are exempt from inspection. Ideal for a club that needs someone to hold the dressing room; his wage demands are as unpretentious as he is.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 同行推荐 · 口碑材料，大体可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Peer recommendation · word-of-mouth material, broadly credible

player.ortega.carlos.claimEn: Seven years in Spain's fourth tier. Club top scorer two seasons running. No pace, but an exceptional nose for the box.
player.ortega.carlos.careerHistory: 2018–2025 西班牙第四级联赛沉睡者联七年，两季当选最佳射手，庆祝动作均为缓慢睁眼。
player.ortega.carlos.careerHistoryEn: 2018–2025 Seven years at Sleepers United in Spain's fourth tier; twice the club's top scorer, both celebrations a slow opening of the eyes.
player.ortega.carlos.expirySubject: 奥尔特加签约数据之光：嗅觉入库
player.ortega.carlos.expirySubjectEn: Ortega signs for Datalight: the nose goes into the database
player.ortega.carlos.expiryBody: Carlos Ortega 已与数据之光签约，该队球探系统给他的评语只有一行：“无速度，禁区嗅觉顶级。”签约发布会上他全程像睡着了，直到有人提到“金靴”两个字才短暂睁眼。俱乐部已把战术板上的禁区颜色加深，据称这样他开会时也能找到位置。
player.ortega.carlos.expiryBodyEn: Carlos Ortega has signed for Datalight United, whose scouting system gave him a one-line review: “No pace; box sense elite.” He appeared to sleep through his own unveiling, eyes opening briefly only when someone said the words “Golden Boot”. The club has darkened the penalty area on its tactics board, so that he can find his position during meetings too.

resumeMail.sender: 沉睡者经纪 · 桑丘
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Carlos Ortega
resumeMail.preview: 禁区里的幽灵，进球时请不要吵醒他。
resumeMail.previewEn: The Ghost in the Box. Please don't wake him when he scores.
resumeMail.body: 推荐前锋 Carlos Ortega：第四级联赛七年老兵，连续两季球队最佳射手，金靴在柜子里。速度方面请放低期待，但只要球进禁区，他比所有人都先醒。适合传中质量尚可、前锋只需跑位的体系。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending forward Carlos Ortega: a seven-year veteran of the fourth tier, the club's top scorer two seasons running, the Golden Boot in his cabinet. Keep expectations low on pace, but the moment the ball enters the box he's awake before everyone else. Suits a system with decent crossing where the striker only needs to move.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 金靴与数据可查
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · Golden Boot and stats verifiable

player.herrera.luis.claimEn: Nine clubs across his career. Lightning quick; consistency unreliable.
player.herrera.luis.evidenceEn: A former teammate: “He can win a match on his own — or go the whole game without finding the ball.”
player.herrera.luis.careerHistory: 2017–2026 九年辗转九队，每队都留下一条被他点燃的边路，和一打没兑现的期待。
player.herrera.luis.careerHistoryEn: 2017–2026 Nine clubs in nine years; each left with a flank he set ablaze and a dozen unfulfilled expectations.
player.herrera.luis.expirySubject: 埃雷拉加盟反击风暴：第十次出发
player.herrera.luis.expirySubjectEn: Herrera joins Counterstorm: setting off for the tenth time
player.herrera.luis.expiryBody: Luis Herrera 与反击风暴签约，职业生涯第十站。主帅看中的是“他可以一个人赢下比赛”的那一面；至于“整场摸不到球”的另一面，俱乐部的方案是“多踢几场总会碰上”。签约当天他在训练场连过四人，随后三天没找到更衣室。
player.herrera.luis.expiryBodyEn: Luis Herrera has signed for Counterstorm FC, the tenth stop of his career. The manager was sold on the version of him that “can win a match on his own”; as for the version that “can't find the ball all game”, the club's plan is “play enough matches and it'll come round”. On signing day he beat four men in training, then spent three days unable to find the dressing room.

resumeMail.sender: 闪电经纪 · 罗哈斯
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Luis Herrera
resumeMail.preview: 快是真的，稳不稳看缘分。
resumeMail.previewEn: The pace is real; the consistency is fate's call.
resumeMail.body: 推荐边锋 Luis Herrera：速度是他的母语，九年九队历练，反击时一个人就是一次进攻。前队友的评价很全面：“他能一个人赢下比赛，也可能整场摸不到球。”适合有冒险精神的教练，建议按场次盲盒的心态使用。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending winger Luis Herrera: speed is his mother tongue, seasoned across nine clubs in nine years — on the counter he is an attack all by himself. A former teammate's verdict covers it: “He can win a match alone, or fail to find the ball for ninety minutes.” Suits adventurous managers; best used with a lucky-dip mentality.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 评价两极，建议试训
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · reviews polarised, trial recommended

player.cooper.liam.claimEn: Released by a professional academy at 17, he fought his way back through semi-pro football. Ordinary technique, but enormous coverage.
player.cooper.liam.careerHistory: 17岁被青训放弃；2019–2023 码头工人联半职业；2023–2026 双半场，覆盖面积以公顷计。
player.cooper.liam.careerHistoryEn: Released by an academy at 17; 2019–2023 semi-pro at Dockworkers United; 2023–2026 Two Halves United, where his coverage is measured in hectares.
player.cooper.liam.expirySubject: 库珀签约湾畔闪电：只问了一个问题
player.cooper.liam.expirySubjectEn: Cooper signs for Bayside Lightning: only one question asked
player.cooper.liam.expiryBody: Liam Cooper 已与湾畔闪电签约。该队老板选人只看跑动，体检时直接跳过其他项目问：“90分钟后他还能跑吗？”库珀掏出伦敦马拉松第56名的证书，谈判就此结束。队医补充：技术测试耗时十二分钟，跑步测试耗时三天——仪器先累了。
player.cooper.liam.expiryBodyEn: Liam Cooper has signed for Bayside Lightning FC, whose owner judges players purely on running. At the medical he skipped every other test to ask: “Can he still run after 90 minutes?” Cooper produced his certificate for 56th place in the London Marathon, and negotiations ended there. The club doctor adds: the technical test took twelve minutes, the running test took three days — the equipment got tired first.

resumeMail.sender: 马拉松经纪 · 布朗
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Liam Cooper
resumeMail.preview: 技术普通，肺不普通。
resumeMail.previewEn: Ordinary technique. Extraordinary lungs.
resumeMail.body: 推荐中场 Liam Cooper：17岁被青训放弃，从半职业联赛一路跑回职业视野。技术层面请保持平常心，但覆盖面积巨大，伦敦马拉松第56名的底子货真价实。适合“战术就是跑”的球队，他能跑到你改战术。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending midfielder Liam Cooper: released at 17, ran his way back from semi-pro football into the professional game. Keep your expectations modest technically, but his coverage is enormous and 56th place in the London Marathon is the real deal. Ideal for a “the tactics are running” side — he'll run until you change your tactics.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 经纪人材料 · 马拉松成绩公开可查
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Agent material · marathon result publicly verifiable

player.turner.jack.claimEn: Worked in construction for years before returning to full-time football. Strong as an ox; utterly reliable in the tackle and in the air.
player.turner.jack.evidenceEn: A teammate: “He plays like he lays bricks — simple, direct, effective.”
player.turner.jack.careerHistory: 2014–2022 白天工地搬砖、周末业余联赛；2022–2026 铸铁镇全职后卫，铲球与砌墙一脉相承。
player.turner.jack.careerHistoryEn: 2014–2022 Building sites by day, Sunday-league football at weekends; 2022–2026 full-time defender at Cast Iron Athletic, where the tackling and the bricklaying come from the same tradition.
player.turner.jack.expirySubject: 特纳签约碰撞城：工人防线落成
player.turner.jack.expirySubjectEn: Turner signs for Collision City: the workmen's defence is completed
player.turner.jack.expiryBody: Jack Turner 已与碰撞城签约两年。该队主帅需要“不介意踢得难看”的后卫，特纳的试训表现让在场所有人想起自家装修。体检报告显示其手掌茧层厚度超出仪器量程，队医在备注栏写道：“建议对手前锋佩戴安全帽。”签约仪式上，他顺手修好了会场摇晃的讲台。
player.turner.jack.expiryBodyEn: Jack Turner has signed a two-year deal with Collision City FC. The manager wanted a defender “who doesn't mind playing ugly”, and Turner's trial reminded everyone present of their own home renovation. The medical found his calluses exceeded the instrument's range; the doctor's note reads: “Opposing forwards are advised to wear hard hats.” At the signing ceremony he casually fixed the venue's wobbly lectern.

resumeMail.sender: 工会经纪 · 老汤姆
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Jack Turner
resumeMail.preview: 建筑工人出身，铲球和头球都有施工许可。
resumeMail.previewEn: Builder by trade; his tackles and headers come with planning permission.
resumeMail.body: 推荐后卫 Jack Turner：建筑行业多年，后转全职球员。身体强壮，铲球、头球均属可靠工种。前队友的评语很传神：“他踢球的动作跟搬砖差不多——简单、直接、有效。”适合后场需要承重墙的球队。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending defender Jack Turner: years in the building trade before turning full-time. Strong as they come; tackling and heading are both reliable trades. A former teammate put it vividly: “He plays like he lays bricks — simple, direct, effective.” Ideal for a side whose back line needs a load-bearing wall.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 工友联名推荐 · 朴实可信
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Joint recommendation from workmates · plainly credible

player.bianchi.franco.claimEn: Works days at the family business, trains with the team at night. Never plays a risky pass — almost always the safest option.
player.bianchi.franco.evidenceEn: His manager: “He may not create chances, but he rarely lets anyone else create one either.”
player.bianchi.franco.careerHistory: 2020–2026 家族企业职员兼谨慎城中场，六年冒险传球次数传闻为零，本人拒绝证实。
player.bianchi.franco.careerHistoryEn: 2020–2026 Family-firm employee and Cautious Town midfielder; risky passes in six years rumoured to total zero — he declined to confirm.
player.bianchi.franco.expirySubject: 比安奇入职银行：风险终于匹配
player.bianchi.franco.expirySubjectEn: Bianchi joins a bank: risk profile finally aligned
player.bianchi.franco.expiryBody: Franco Bianchi 宣布挂靴，入职家族企业隔壁的银行，负责风险评估。告别发布会上他表示：“足球教会我最重要的一课就是不要冒险传球，银行业深以为然。”队友透露，他职业生涯最后一次触球选择回传门将，全场鼓掌——这脚球他考虑了八年。
player.bianchi.franco.expiryBodyEn: Franco Bianchi has retired to join the bank next door to the family firm, working in risk assessment. “The most important lesson football taught me,” he said at the farewell presser, “is never to play a risky pass — and banking heartily agrees.” Teammates reveal his final touch as a professional was a back-pass to the keeper, applauded by the whole ground: he'd been considering that pass for eight years.

resumeMail.sender: 本人直邮 · F. 比安奇
resumeMail.senderEn: Direct mail from the man himself · F. Bianchi
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Franco Bianchi · 稳健型
resumeMail.subjectEn: Player CV: Franco Bianchi · steady type
resumeMail.preview: 不创造机会，也不给别人创造机会。
resumeMail.previewEn: Creates no chances; lets no one else create any either.
resumeMail.body: 您好，本人 Franco Bianchi 自荐：白天在家族企业上班，晚上参加训练，出勤稳定。踢球哲学是每一脚传球都有明确去处。教练评价我“可能不创造机会，但很少让别人创造机会”。若贵队中场需要一根保险丝，我随叫随到。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Hello, Franco Bianchi here, applying directly: days at the family business, evenings at training, attendance impeccable. My footballing philosophy is that every pass has a declared destination. My manager says I “may not create chances, but rarely let anyone else create one either”. Should your midfield need a fuse, I am available at short notice.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 球员自荐 · 教练评语出处未核实
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Player self-recommendation · manager's quote unverified

player.navarro.miguel.claimEn: Once in a professional academy, released for being too short. Quick reactions, especially dominant on high balls.
player.navarro.miguel.evidenceEn: Best claim success rate in Spain's third tier.
player.navarro.miguel.careerHistory: 2019–2022 职业梯队（因身高被放弃）；2022–2026 第三级联赛云雀竞技，出击次数与海拔成反比。
player.navarro.miguel.careerHistoryEn: 2019–2022 Professional academy (released over his height); 2022–2026 Skylark Athletic in the third tier, where his claims off the line are inversely proportional to his altitude.
player.navarro.miguel.expirySubject: 纳瓦罗签约附件科技：他不闭眼
player.navarro.miguel.expirySubjectEn: Navarro signs for Attachment Tech: he doesn't close his eyes
player.navarro.miguel.expiryBody: Miguel Navarro 已与企业联赛的附件科技签约。该公司此前的门将“每次对方射门都闭眼”，人事部把招聘要求写成“至少不躲球”。纳瓦罗试训当天连续三次出击摘下高球，行政主管当场拍板。合同特别注明：茶水间柜子顶层今后由他负责。
player.navarro.miguel.expiryBodyEn: Miguel Navarro has signed for Attachment Tech FC of the corporate league. The company's previous keeper “closed his eyes every time the opposition shot”, so HR worded the job spec “must at least not duck”. Navarro claimed three high balls in a row on trial day and the admin director signed him on the spot. A special clause in the contract makes him responsible for the top shelf of the kitchen cupboard from now on.

resumeMail.sender: 小个门将联盟 · 秘书
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：Miguel Navarro
resumeMail.preview: 身高是过去式，出击是现在进行时。
resumeMail.previewEn: His height is past tense; his coming off the line is present continuous.
resumeMail.body: 推荐门将 Miguel Navarro：职业梯队出身，当年因身高被放弃，如今在第三级联赛练出顶级反应，高空球出击成功率联赛第一。他用五年证明那张放弃通知书写错了一个词。弹跳与判断俱佳，转会费同样不高。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending goalkeeper Miguel Navarro: academy-bred, released back then over his height, now owner of elite reactions in the third tier — league-best success rate coming for high balls. He has spent five years proving the release letter misspelt one word. Superb leap and judgement; the fee, like him, is not tall.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 联盟数据附后 · 出击统计可查
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Alliance data attached · claim statistics verifiable

player.moreira.andre.amateur.claimEn: A local amateur player who sought you out to see if there's a chance. Strong at assists; defending is rough.
player.moreira.andre.amateur.evidenceEn: Plenty of assists; teammates say they all love him.
player.moreira.andre.amateur.careerHistory: 2021–2026 阳光周日联队（业余），五年助攻无数，防守纪录无人愿意整理。
player.moreira.andre.amateur.careerHistoryEn: 2021–2026 Sunshine Sunday XI (amateur); five years of countless assists, and defensive records nobody is willing to compile.
player.moreira.andre.amateur.expirySubject: 莫雷拉留在业余队：联名挽留成功
player.moreira.andre.amateur.expirySubjectEn: Moreira stays amateur: the petition succeeds
player.moreira.andre.amateur.expiryBody: André Moreira 决定暂不与职业队签约，继续效力本地业余球队。队友们得知后众筹给他换了双新鞋，并在请愿书上写道：“他助攻多、人招人喜欢，他走了谁给我们喂饼？”莫雷拉本人表示职业梦想先寄存，“周日早上有人等我传球，这比合同重要”。
player.moreira.andre.amateur.expiryBodyEn: André Moreira has decided not to sign professionally for now, staying with his local amateur side. His teammates crowdfunded him a new pair of boots and wrote on the petition: “He gives us assists and everyone loves him — if he goes, who lays on our goals?” Moreira says the pro dream can go into storage: “On Sunday mornings people are waiting for my passes. That matters more than a contract.”

resumeMail.sender: 周日联队 · 全体队友
resumeMail.subject: 球员简历：André Moreira
resumeMail.preview: 业余联赛助攻小王子，防守部分请自行想象。
resumeMail.previewEn: Sunday-league assist prince; the defending is left to your imagination.
resumeMail.body: 替我们队的 André Moreira 投份简历：本地业余联赛多年主力边锋，助攻能力是队内公共财产，谁都喜欢他。防守方面我们一致决定不在信里展开。他想试试职业足球，我们觉得可以试试——反正周日的比赛他还回来踢。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Sending a CV for our André Moreira: first-choice winger in the local amateur league for years, his assists are common property in the squad and everyone loves him. On the defensive side we have unanimously decided not to elaborate in this letter. He wants a crack at professional football; we think it's worth a try — he'll be back for the Sunday games anyway.
resumeMail.sourceNote: 队友代投 · 感情分高，请自行甄别
resumeMail.sourceNoteEn: Submitted by teammates · high sentimental value, please verify yourself

player.hayes.robert.claimEn: Four million followers across the platforms; seeking a professional club willing to take him on and fulfil his childhood dream.
player.hayes.robert.evidenceEn: The videos on his account showcase superb skills.
player.hayes.robert.careerHistory: 2023–2026 自家客厅与各大短视频平台，职业出场零次，播放量已经破亿。
player.hayes.robert.careerHistoryEn: 2023–2026 His own living room and every short-video platform going; zero professional appearances, over a hundred million views.
player.hayes.robert.expirySubject: 海耶斯转行：全职回归镜头前
player.hayes.robert.expirySubjectEn: Hayes changes careers: back in front of the camera full-time

Journalists combed his registration paperwork and found the only certainty remains the line “age meets registration requirements”. His old teammates aren't surprised: “He's been playing football longer than we know — of course he wouldn't tell us he's retired.”

The manager said only: “Have him do it again tomorrow.” The next day, he genuinely did it again.

resumeMail.body: 推荐前锋 Carlos Mendez：前西班牙U21国脚，踢过两个赛季顶级联赛，上赛季金靴竞争者。禁区内抢点与单刀能力突出，属于“把机会给我就行”的类型。坊间关于浪费机会的说法，我方认为与他创造的进球不成正比，欢迎面谈。
resumeMail.bodyEn: Recommending forward Carlos Mendez: former Spain U21 international with two top-flight seasons, a Golden Boot contender last year. His poaching and one-on-ones in the box are outstanding — the “just give me the chance” type. The chatter about wasted chances is, in our view, out of proportion to the goals he delivers; happy to discuss in person.
